## Current Role

Senior Software Infrastructure Engineer / Technical Lead at **Apple Inc.** (Sunnyvale, CA — May 2019 – Present). Architects infrastructure for a manufacturing organization of 30+ engineers. Areas:

- Quality sampling engine processing millions of daily inspections (Go, Lua, Redis).
- Machine learning platform automating model deployment to factories.
- MSI Cloud Engineering initiative: migrating manufacturing infrastructure to cloud vendors, including Snowflake adoption for cross-team data access and Kafka/Redis event-driven pipelines (Java, AWS, Kubernetes).
- Embedded systems conversion from iOS to Go, enabling bi-directional production-line communication at remote factories (Bash, Python, PowerShell, mDNS, IPv6).
- Automated AI code and compliance reviewer for the organization: multi-model (Claude, Gemini) pull request review, severity-ranked findings, and security and policy-compliance gating (Python, Go, Bash).
- Autonomous fix-test-commit-reply cycles wired into CI/CD.
- Internal AI agent plugin ecosystem (agents, commands, reusable skills) for code review, security, release engineering, and multi-agent orchestration, adopted across engineering teams.

## Career Highlights

- **Apple** (2019–Present) — Senior Software Infrastructure Engineer / Technical Lead. Manufacturing infrastructure, machine learning platform, AI initiatives.
- **Roblox** (2018–2019) — Principal Software Engineer, Infrastructure Services. Contributed to platform infrastructure supporting 100M+ monthly active users; worked on service reliability and .NET Core migration.
- **eBay** (2016–2018) — Principal Software Engineer, Data Services and Solutions. Architected a unified data query layer using Apache Calcite over 7+ heterogeneous data stores (Elasticsearch, Cassandra, MongoDB, Couchbase, and more), eliminating the need for teams to write store-specific queries. Deployed on Kubernetes, it became eBay's standard cross-platform data access interface.
- **@WalmartLabs** (2014–2016) — Staff Software Engineer, Smart Sourcing. Built the sourcing optimization engine for Walmart.com's supply chain, reducing fulfillment costs by algorithmically selecting optimal distribution centers per order; delivered real-time dashboards and alerts for supply chain operators.
- **Addepar** (2013–2014) — Software Engineer. Worked on the Data team, then the Architecture team; parallelized and optimized services to perform 10x better.
- **@WalmartLabs** (2012–2013) — Staff Software Engineer, Smart Pricing. Designed the big data infrastructure powering daily pricing strategy (Java, Spring, Hibernate, Hive, Cassandra, Solr, LevelDB); built APIs and dashboards for pricing analysts across millions of SKUs.
- **Amazon** (2011–2012) — Software Development Engineer, Search Experience. Visually Similar search, Mason-to-Java migration, mobile search, and multi-language search with CJK tokenization via Lucene.
- **Microsoft** (2008–2011) — Software Development Engineer II. Office Mobile Shared Services (OneNote on Symbian; C++, RVCT compiler, QML); Mobile Advertising automated test framework for iPhone ad components.
- **Yahoo!** (2007–2008; intern 2006) — Technical Yahoo!, Yahoo! Search Marketing. Ad keyword canonicalization service (C++) powering targeting across 20+ international markets at 10,000 QPS; as an intern, a multilingual test framework (C++) for Yahoo! Search's semantic library.
